Set a chart's statistical transformation

set_stat.Rd

How y is derived from the data. "identity" plots y verbatim, one mark per row; every other value aggregates y grouped by x. "count" needs no y - it counts rows per x.

Usage

set_stat(chart, stat)

Arguments

chart

An ArcChart, from arc_chart() with set_type() already called.

stat

One of "identity", "count", "sum", "mean", "min", "max", "sd", "var".

Value

chart, with its stat set.

Details

Bar and line charts only; scatterplots ignore it.
